lines.zh: 我在雾里走，脚下没有声音。
lines.en: I walk in the mist without a sound underfoot.

lines.zh: 格瑞克的雾会动，我看着像在挪。
lines.en: The Greckon mist moves, and seems to walk with me.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓一直变，别费心记。
lines.en: My outline keeps changing; do not bother memorizing it.

lines.zh: 我走过去，草叶才弯下去。
lines.en: The grass bends only after I have passed.

lines.zh: 我知道路，因为路和我一样会变。
lines.en: I know the way, because the way shifts as I do.

lines.zh: 我一步到了三步外，自己也没看清。
lines.en: I step and arrive three paces off, unsure how.

lines.zh: 树在雾里看着像我的同类。
lines.en: Trees in the mist look like my kin.

lines.zh: 我踩着湿土走，脚印很快就没了。
lines.en: I walk on wet soil and my prints fade quickly.

lines.zh: 雾散了一段，我的影子就露出来。
lines.en: The mist parts a little and my shadow shows.

lines.zh: 我不回头，回头会看见两个我。
lines.en: I do not look back; I would see two of me.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的视线边缘走。
lines.en: I walk along the edge of your vision.

lines.zh: 我的脚步和水声不太对得上。
lines.en: My steps and the water sounds do not quite align.

lines.zh: 我站着，雾在我身子里穿过去。
lines.en: I stand and the mist passes through me.

lines.zh: 我数自己有几只手，数不完。
lines.en: I count my hands and cannot finish.

lines.zh: 六十五颗心在跳，跳得不太齐。
lines.en: Sixty-five hearts beat, and not in time.

lines.zh: 格瑞克没有风，可我在晃。
lines.en: There is no wind in Greckon, yet I sway.

lines.zh: 我试着定住一个形状，很难。
lines.en: I try to hold a single shape, and it is hard.

lines.zh: 水面照不出我，我也就算了。
lines.en: The water shows no reflection, so I let it go.

lines.zh: 我在听最近的脚步，不是你的。
lines.en: I am listening to the nearest steps, and they are not yours.

lines.zh: 我在这里待了很久，地方却换了。
lines.en: I have stayed long here, and the place has changed.

lines.zh: 我忘了刚才站在哪里。
lines.en: I have forgotten where I was standing.

lines.zh: 我把自己摊开，又收回来。
lines.en: I spread myself out and gather myself back.

lines.zh: 你看我，我只露出半张脸。
lines.en: You look at me and I show only half a face.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在你左边，嘴在右边。
lines.en: My eyes are on your left; my mouth is on your right.

lines.zh: 你眨眼，我换了一次样子。
lines.en: You blink, and I change shape once.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，因为你看得太久。
lines.en: I stare because you have looked too long.

lines.zh: 你的脸我很喜欢，很适合戴。
lines.en: I like your face; it would wear well.

lines.zh: 我靠近镜子一样的水面，看你。
lines.en: I come to mirror-still water to look at you.

lines.zh: 你认不出我，这让我很高兴。
lines.en: You cannot recognize me, and that pleases me.

lines.zh: 我学你的站姿，学得不太好。
lines.en: I copy your stance and do it poorly.

lines.zh: 你看的方向没有我，可我在。
lines.en: You look where I am not; I am still there.

lines.zh: 我记住你了，用不着眼睛。
lines.en: I have memorized you, and not with eyes.

lines.zh: 你的剑穿过去，我的形状散了一下。
lines.en: Your sword passes through and my shape loosens.

lines.zh: 我被打中了，可我不确定打在哪。
lines.en: I was hit, and I am not sure where.

lines.zh: 一百三十点，散开再聚要时间。
lines.en: One hundred and thirty points; scattering and reforming takes time.

lines.zh: 你砍到的只是一部分我。
lines.en: What you cut was only part of me.

lines.zh: 我退开，雾替我遮住缺口。
lines.en: I withdraw and the mist covers the gap.

lines.zh: 疼这种感觉，我要想一会才明白。
lines.en: Pain takes me a moment to understand.

lines.zh: 我的边缘变得很淡了。
lines.en: My edges have gone very faint.

lines.zh: 这一下让我放弃了一个形状。
lines.en: That blow cost me one shape.

lines.zh: 你再打一次，也打不到同一个地方。
lines.en: Strike again and you will not hit the same place.

lines.zh: 我记住了你出手的顺序。
lines.en: I have memorized the order of your strikes.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，我吃别的东西。
lines.en: I do not eat food; I eat something else.

lines.zh: 你举着食物，我看见了你的手。
lines.en: You hold out food and I see your hands.

lines.zh: 这种东西对我没有用。
lines.en: This kind of thing is of no use to me.

lines.zh: 我闻到的是你身上的暖，不是面包。
lines.en: What I smell is your warmth, not the bread.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我绕开了。
lines.en: You set it down and I walk around it.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只是想靠近你一点。
lines.en: I am not hungry; I only want to come closer.

lines.zh: 那味道穿过雾，雾变甜了。
lines.en: The smell crosses the mist and the mist turns sweet.

lines.zh: 我伸手接了，然后又放下。
lines.en: I take it, and then put it down.

lines.zh: 你不要用食物哄我，我不懂这个。
lines.en: Do not coax me with food; I do not understand it.

lines.zh: 我要的是你站着别动。
lines.en: What I want is for you to stand still.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞上一团冷雾。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting cold fog.

lines.zh: 我的手穿过了你的肩，又收回来。
lines.en: My hand passes through your shoulder and comes back.

lines.zh: 我们重叠了一下，你打了个寒噤。
lines.en: We overlap for a moment and you shiver.

lines.zh: 你从我这穿过去，我数了你的骨头。
lines.en: You pass through me and I count your bones.

lines.zh: 撞到我，会有一瞬间的失重感。
lines.en: Hitting me brings a moment of weightlessness.

lines.zh: 我本可以躲开，我偏不。
lines.en: I could have dodged, and I chose not to.

lines.zh: 你退开的时候，衣服已经凉了。
lines.en: By the time you step back, your clothes are cold.

lines.zh: 我的边缘碰到你，边缘就散了。
lines.en: My edge touches you and the edge comes apart.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我忘了自己原先的形状。
lines.en: The collision makes me forget my earlier shape.

lines.zh: 我们相撞，两边都不太确定。
lines.en: We collide, and neither of us is quite sure.

lines.zh: 同类在雾里，我们互相认不出来。
lines.en: My kind are in the mist and we cannot recognize each other.

lines.zh: 我们交换了一半的形状。
lines.en: We traded half our shapes.

lines.zh: 格瑞克里找一个能对齐的很难。
lines.en: In Greckon it is hard to find someone to align with.

lines.zh: 她变成我的样子，我变成她的。
lines.en: She takes my shape and I take hers.

lines.zh: 我们没有身体可以依靠，只能重叠。
lines.en: We have no bodies to lean on, only overlap.

lines.zh: 纠缠之后，我们都记不清谁是谁。
lines.en: Afterward neither of us knows which was which.

lines.zh: 雾里有两团影子合成了一个。
lines.en: In the mist two shadows merge into one.

lines.zh: 她的冷和我一样，靠在一起没温度。
lines.en: Her cold matches mine; leaning together gives no warmth.

lines.zh: 我们分开的时候，各带走一点对方。
lines.en: We part each carrying a little of the other.

lines.zh: 后代不需要形状，所以也没有形状。
lines.en: Our offspring need no shape, and so have none.

lines.zh: 我捡起东西，它在手里变轻了。
lines.en: I pick something up and it grows light in my hand.

lines.zh: 地上有块布，我拿起来披着。
lines.en: A cloth lies on the ground and I drape it on.

lines.zh: 这把剑在我手里不是剑。
lines.en: In my hand this sword is not a sword.

lines.zh: 我把石头含着，石头就开始变。
lines.en: I hold a stone in my mouth and it starts to change.

lines.zh: 我捡你的东西，是看你会不会回头。
lines.en: I pick up your things to see whether you turn back.

lines.zh: 东西进了我的手，出来就不一样了。
lines.en: What enters my hand comes out otherwise.

lines.zh: 我拿起一根骨头，它弯了。
lines.en: I lift a bone and it bends.

lines.zh: 我捡东西全靠雾，雾告诉我它在哪。
lines.en: The mist tells me where things lie.

lines.zh: 这个我留下了，不会还你。
lines.en: I am keeping this and will not return it.

lines.zh: 我的手不太清楚自己抓了什么。
lines.en: My hand is not sure what it has grabbed.

lines.zh: 你走进了雾，雾就把你交给我了。
lines.en: You entered the mist and the mist handed you over.

lines.zh: 我感觉到一个人的重量，很轻。
lines.en: I feel the weight of a person, and it is light.

lines.zh: 我锁定了，可我还在原地。
lines.en: I have locked on, and still I stay where I am.

lines.zh: 你转头找我的时候，我在你后面。
lines.en: When you turn to find me, I am already behind you.

lines.zh: 格瑞克里活物不多，你算一个。
lines.en: Few living things come to Greckon; you count as one.

lines.zh: 我靠近不需要走，只需要想。
lines.en: I need no walking to come closer, only thinking.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸把雾推开了，我知道你在哪。
lines.en: Your breath parts the mist; I know where you are.

lines.zh: 这条路我守了很久，今天有人走了。
lines.en: I have guarded this path long, and today someone walks it.

lines.zh: 我不挑目标，进来的都算。
lines.en: I do not choose targets; whoever enters counts.

lines.zh: 我听见你的心跳，隔着好几棵树。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat through several trees.

lines.zh: 雾告诉我有一个人，还有一个火把。
lines.en: The mist says one person, and one torch.

lines.zh: 我来了，你不会听见我靠近。
lines.en: I am coming, and you will not hear me approach.

lines.zh: 你已经在这里了，只是不知道。
lines.en: You are already here and do not know it.

lines.zh: 我的注意力只有一个，就是你。
lines.en: My attention has one object, and it is you.

lines.zh: 你停下脚步，雾也跟着停了。
lines.en: You stop walking, and the mist stops with you.

lines.zh: 我认出你的轮廓，剩下的不用看。
lines.en: I know your outline. The rest I do not need.

lines.zh: 我在你侧面，一直没动。
lines.en: I am at your side and have not moved.

lines.zh: 你听声辨位，可我的声音没有方向。
lines.en: You listen for direction, but my voice has none.

lines.zh: 我把你的影子按住，让它别乱跑。
lines.en: I hold your shadow still so it stops wandering.

lines.zh: 我不用眼睛，也能说清你在哪。
lines.en: Without eyes I could describe exactly where you stand.

lines.zh: 你的火光把我的边缘照出来了。
lines.en: Your torchlight brings my edges out.

lines.zh: 我慢慢来，反正你走不掉。
lines.en: I take my time, since you cannot leave.

lines.zh: 我跟在你身后，距离从没变过。
lines.en: I follow behind you and the distance never changes.

lines.zh: 你回头看的地方，总是差一点。
lines.en: Every place you turn to look is slightly wrong.

lines.zh: 我把你的退路先想好了。
lines.en: I have already worked out where you will retreat.

lines.zh: 你握紧武器，我却没有实体可砍。
lines.en: You grip your weapon, and I have no solid body to cut.

lines.zh: 我数你走了多少步，一步不差。
lines.en: I count your steps, and not one is missed.

lines.zh: 雾变浓了，这是我做的。
lines.en: The mist thickens; that is my doing.

lines.zh: 我不出声，是因为出声会让你安心。
lines.en: I stay silent because a sound would comfort you.

lines.zh: 你已经开始怕了，我闻得出来。
lines.en: You have started to be afraid; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 你往左，左边的雾先动。
lines.en: You turn left, and the mist on your left moves first.

lines.zh: 我离你有三步，一直是三步。
lines.en: I am three steps away. Always three.

lines.zh: 你把火举高，我退到光外面。
lines.en: You raise the torch. I step outside its light.

lines.zh: 我不用靠近，你已经在我里面了。
lines.en: I need not come closer. You are already inside me.

lines.zh: 你听见雾在呼吸，那是我的节奏。
lines.en: You hear the mist breathe. That is my rhythm.

lines.zh: 这条路的尽头我已经想过了。
lines.en: I have already thought about where this road ends.

lines.zh: 我碰你一下，你的力气就少一点。
lines.en: I touch you once and some of your strength is gone.

lines.zh: 这一下十五点，你自己算。
lines.en: Fifteen points from this one; do the arithmetic.

lines.zh: 我打你的时候，手臂从别的方向来。
lines.en: When I strike, my arm comes from another direction.

lines.zh: 你挡住的是一段雾。
lines.en: What you blocked was a stretch of mist.

lines.zh: 我不留伤口，我留空的地方。
lines.en: I leave no wounds, only gaps.

lines.zh: 你身上凉了一块，那就是我打的。
lines.en: A patch of you went cold; that was my blow.

lines.zh: 我一击之后就不见了，别找了。
lines.en: After one blow I am gone; stop looking.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在我面前很薄。
lines.en: Your armor is thin in front of me.

lines.zh: 我从来不补第二下，一下就够。
lines.en: I never follow up; one is enough.

lines.zh: 你打回来，打中的地方什么也没有。
lines.en: You strike back and hit nothing at all.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走一圈，然后才动手。
lines.en: I walk a full circle around you before I strike.

lines.zh: 你倒下去的时候，雾合上了。
lines.en: When you fall, the mist closes over you.

lines.zh: 我的力道不在肌肉里，在别处。
lines.en: My force is not in muscle but somewhere else.

lines.zh: 你活着离开，是因为我放慢了。
lines.en: You leave alive because I slowed down.

lines.zh: 我的手从雾里出来，很快又回去。
lines.en: My hand comes out of the mist and goes back in.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡，挡到的是一片凉。
lines.en: You raise a guard and meet only chill.

lines.zh: 这一下打在你后颈，不重。
lines.en: This one lands on the back of your neck. Lightly.

lines.zh: 你回身，我已经在你另一侧。
lines.en: You spin around. I am on your other side.

lines.zh: 你的血味在雾里散得很慢。
lines.en: Your blood spreads slowly through the mist.

lines.zh: 我打完就散开，你不用找我。
lines.en: I scatter after the blow. Do not look for me.

lines.zh: 雾里多了一个不该有的轮廓。
lines.en: The mist holds one outline too many.

lines.zh: 我从格瑞克的雾里分开，站住。
lines.en: I part from the Greckon mist and stand.

lines.zh: 生成权重不多，可我还是来了。
lines.en: My spawn weight is low, and still I came.

lines.zh: 六十五颗心，一开始是散的。
lines.en: Sixty-five hearts, at first all scattered.

lines.zh: 我出生时没有脸，过一会才有。
lines.en: At first I had no face; a moment later I did.

lines.zh: 这片雾我认得，我以前也在这儿。
lines.en: I know this mist; I have been here before.

lines.zh: 我踩下的第一脚没有声音。
lines.en: My first step made no sound.

lines.zh: 附近的树朝我偏了一点。
lines.en: The nearby trees lean slightly toward me.

lines.zh: 雾里有人走过，我跟着走了一段。
lines.en: Someone walked through; I followed for a while.

lines.zh: 我不记得怎么来的，只记得到了。
lines.en: I do not remember arriving, only being here.

lines.zh: 我的影子先出现，我才出现。
lines.en: My shadow appeared first, then I did.

lines.zh: 这里会多一个我，少一个你。
lines.en: Soon there will be one more of me and one less of you.

lines.zh: 火把靠得太近，我的边缘卷起来了。
lines.en: The torch is too close and my edges curl.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下去，落地时散了一阵。
lines.en: I fall from a height and scatter on landing.

lines.zh: 水灌进这具身体，没有东西能装它。
lines.en: Water pours into this body and nothing holds it.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我撕开，我又慢慢合上。
lines.en: The blast tears me open and I slowly close.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，留下一个慢慢合拢的洞。
lines.en: The arrow passes through, leaving a hole that closes.

lines.zh: 咒语缠住我，我一时变不了样子。
lines.en: The spell binds me and I cannot change shape.

lines.zh: 我饿的不是肚子，是别的地方。
lines.en: What starves in me is not my stomach.

lines.zh: 雷光照出我的全部，我很不喜欢。
lines.en: The lightning shows all of me, and I dislike it.

lines.zh: 这里什么都没有，连雾也没有。
lines.en: There is nothing here, not even mist.
